items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 35:1
items.html: Because of the striking and clashing of the descending reflected light with the record, by reason of their oppositeness, the descending reflected light prevailed over the record and entered into the vessel. And the two of them cannot be in one vessel, for there are no two opposites in one subject; the record is therefore compelled to go out from there, and it rises above the vessel and shines to the vessel a minute illumination, in the secret of “Tagin [crownlets].” (Chapter 4, Inner Light, Item 7)
